message.content: The HEAD commit is `5ef8e05c9` "Merge branch 'fix-pkcs12-iter' into 'master'" which contains `495aa9b57 pkcs12: do not go try calculating pbkdf2 with 0 iterations`. This is the fix for the vulnerability. Let me look at that commit.

commit 495aa9b57a3ce3ee546a0498ef232b4aa47d0f51
Author: Dmitry Baryshkov <dbaryshkov@gmail.com>
Date:   Tue Jan 28 13:05:14 2020 +0300

    pkcs12: do not go try calculating pbkdf2 with 0 iterations

    Nettle will abort on a call to pbkdf2 if iterations is 0. Add check to
    GnuTLS PKCS12 GOST code to check that iter is not 0.

    Signed-off-by: Dmitry Baryshkov <dbaryshkov@gmail.com>
